fact: In 2024/25 the Regulator received 1,355 POPIA complaints and resolved 745, issued five POPIA enforcement notices (Blouberg Local Municipality, Lancet Laboratories, Electoral Commission, WhatsApp LLC, Department of Basic Education) and three infringement notices with administrative fines of R200,000 (FT Rams), R100,000 (Electoral Commission) and R5 million (Department of Basic Education).
title: Information Regulator Annual Report for the year ended 31 March 2025
